definitions.explanation: The time of year when a business is at its busiest and earns the most revenue.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}は{書|か}き{入|い}れ{時|どき}だ。
examples.english: Year-end is the peak business season.

examples.japanese: クリスマスはケーキ{屋|や}の{書|か}き{入|い}れ{時|どき}だ。
examples.english: Christmas is the busy season for cake shops.

examples.japanese: {書|か}き{入|い}れ{時|どき}に{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}すわけにはいかない。
examples.english: I can't afford to get sick during the busy season.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{書|か}き{入|い}れ refers to writing entries in an account book. The {時|どき} (time/period) when merchants were busiest writing in sales was the peak earning period, hence the meaning.

USAGE:
Used for any business or industry's peak earning period. Often appears in news and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年末|ねんまつ}の{書|か}き{入|い}れ{時|どき}: year-end busy season
- {夏|なつ}の{書|か}き{入|い}れ{時|どき}: summer busy season
- {書|か}き{入|い}れ{時|どき}を{迎|むか}える: to enter the busy season
